answers.project_description: DISC Personality Test in PHP language based on DISC Classic
answers.problem_statement: Organizations and recruiters need a lightweight, self-hosted way to administer and interpret DISC behavioral assessments without expensive subscriptions
answers.target_users: Developers building recruitment portals or integrating psychometric tests into HR systems
answers.key_goals: Enable easy embeddability into external HR/recruitment systems with multilingual support and zero external runtime dependencies
answers.frontend_framework: Vanilla HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript (no heavyweight framework)
answers.backend_framework: None / Native PHP (Vanilla PHP with PSR-4 autoloading)
answers.infrastructure: Self-hosted / Traditional LAMP/LEMP or Docker (Apache/Nginx + PHP + MySQL)
answers.commit_strategy: Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:, test:)
answers.styleguide_languages: PHP (PSR-12 / Clean Architecture with PHP 8.3+ portability)
answers.existing_conventions: Yes, incorporate GEMINI.md conventions (PHP 8.3 compatibility, header formats) and PHPUnit
